Q, Stacking the Deck

Legendary Creature — Q · {2}{R}{R} · Catalog face mana value 4 · 4/4

When Q enters, shuffle your library, then exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. That nonland card gains "Exile a card from your hand: Create a copy of this card. You may cast the copy. Activate only during your turn and only if this card is exiled."

Sets: TRK

Not legal: alchemy, oldschool, pauper, paupercommander, penny, predh, premodern, tlr.

Legal: brawl, commander, competitivebrawl, duel, future, gladiator, historic, legacy, modern, oathbreaker, pioneer, standard, standardbrawl, timeless, vintage.
